text: 1255 replaces contentDocument null checks with browser.ownerDocument.readyState in five test families. Those current predicates still test the owner document, which alone does not prove the inner page has completed loading. A scoped recommendation when editing these waits is to check the inner load state or webProgress and the expected non-blank URL, as the extension awaitBrowserLoaded helper does. This static distinction is not an observed race reproduction or a diagnosis of the original intermittent failure. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Distinguish a browser owner document from the document loaded inside it
